_comment: Trust-ladder state for the model-router review loop. Lives OUTSIDE routes.jsonl deliberately: if the log is ever truncated or rotated, the rung must not silently reset. Written by the Phase 3.5 review pass and by rung changes only. rung 1 = propose only; 2 = auto-write mechanical ops; 3 = auto-write new lessons.

graduation_requires.rung_1_to_2: 5 lessons whose falsifiable prediction was later CONFIRMED by a route outcome. Approval alone does not count.
graduation_requires.rung_2_to_3: 10 further confirmed predictions at rung 2 with zero reverted auto-edits.

demotion_rule: Any auto-written lesson that the user reverts, or any lesson whose prediction is REFUTED, drops the rung by one immediately and resets passes_at_rung to 0.
